body: Lil Durk @lildurk’s federal trial entered day 13 today as supporters gathered outside the Los Angeles courthouse holding “Free Durk” signs and showing their support for the rapper 🙏 Via; Closing arguments have now begun, giving both the prosecution and defense their final opportunity to address the jury after nearly three weeks of courtroom proceedings. Once closing arguments conclude, the case is expected to be handed over to the jury for deliberations as fans await the final decision.
